How to access your Room Alert's Settings pages

By default, no username/password required

By default, your Room Alert has no username or password. You'll be prompted for them anyway. Leave them both blank and simply click "OK" or "Sign in".

If you've previously saved a username or password on your Room Alert, enter them when prompted and then click "OK" or "Sign in".

If you've previously saved a password on your Room Alert, enter it when prompted, leave the username blank, and then click "OK" or "Sign in".

Questions? See this FAQ: How To Access A Room Alert Monitor’s Settings Pages
